supersedes_scope.note: Version 1 covers the resource, field, geometry and receipt work and its borrowed theorem. This contract covers a different question and does not widen version 1; the triple-intersection judgement under the imported theorem stays exactly as version 1 records it.

question: Can Milnor's invariant mu-bar(123) be recomputed from a complement-side presentation of the three components by a route independent of the triple intersection number of Seifert surfaces?
level: External exact algebra on finitely presented groups; no native Adva, Rust or Lisp operation
why_a_new_contract: A complement-side route needs machinery this line does not carry: a declared diagram or presentation input, free-group words with a truncated Magnus expansion, and an extraction rule for the invariant. Adding that machinery silently inside version 1 would widen a frozen scope.
objects: free group on n generators with words as signed generator sequences and exact reduction
commutators, conjugation and the Hall basic commutators with their weight and order
the lower central series quotients gamma_w / gamma_{w+1} and the Witt rank counts
a declared link presentation (not yet supplied) and its meridians
the truncated Magnus expansion and the extraction of mu-bar(123) from the relation words

types.words: tuples of non-zero integers; sign is the inverse; reduction cancels adjacent inverse pairs
types.coefficients: exact integers; no rational or floating arithmetic is used
types.presentations: generators with relator words; abelianisation is computed exactly as a Smith-style rank, not by heuristics

quantifiers: All basic commutators of weight at most four on two and on three generators
The Hall-Witt identity as a word identity, tested under both conjugation conventions and required to hold in exactly one
No search over presentations, no random words, no unbounded rewriting
assumptions: Hall's basis and Witt's formula are classical and are imported; the run checks the counts they predict but does not re-prove them
The identification of pairwise linking numbers with the abelianisation of the link group is imported
The triple-intersection route of version 1 is the only executed judgement of the Borromean configuration so far
protected: The version 1 witness, the frozen contract and its amendment history keep their bytes
No status in the queue is closed by this contract
The plates, the captured PDF and the plotting script stay outside this line
acceptance: Word reduction, inversion and commutator algebra are implemented with exact integer words and pass the Hall-Witt identity under exactly one declared conjugation convention.
The Hall basic commutators reproduce Witt's rank counts for two and three generators up to weight four: 2/1/2/3 and 3/3/8/18.
The run reports that mu-bar(123) itself is not computed, and the presentation input, the Magnus expansion and the extraction rule stay open.
unknown: Any bound, or a missing presentation input, stops the run as Unknown; no partial invariant is reported
replay: python3 -S experiments/golden_ratio/complement.py --output target/complement-fresh.json (the output path must not exist)
